posts.body: I’m building Tryambakam Noesis: tools and writing for examining how we notice, interpret and choose. I’ll share design decisions, essays and small practices as the work takes shape. What part of making do you wish builders showed more clearly?

One decision in the publishing workflow I’m building: every draft stops for review. Copy, destination and delivery settings stay attached to the item. Generating more should leave me with clearer choices about what deserves to be read.

After an insight, there is still the next request, the next interruption, the next choice. I’m writing about that interval: what becomes visible when attention moves from the realization to the response?

A five-field record: trigger, signal, felt shift, action, story. “A request arrived” and “they needed an immediate answer” belong in different fields. I’m developing a worksheet that leaves room to say: I don’t know yet.
